statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-0636 (GHSA-c3fc-8qff-9hwx): org.bouncycastle.x509.util.LDAPStoreHelper in Bouncy Castle bcprov built LDAP search filters from unescaped input, allowing LDAP injection. bcprov-jdk18on is affected from 1.74 before 1.80.2, from 1.81 before 1.81.1 and from 1.82 before 1.84 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c3fc-8qff-9hwx, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%900636, fix commit https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/commit/d20cdb8430e09224114fec0179a71859929fcbde). We read every jar, nested jars included, in every published gradle-8 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, 16 versions from 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.8-r0, after verifying each package against its index checksum; the x86_64 and aarch64 packages of each version have the same checksum, and 8.14.5-r4 is published for x86_64 only. Bouncy Castle classes appear only in /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/plugins/bcprov-jdk18on, bcpg-jdk18on and bcutil-jdk18on jars, and only the bcprov jar contains LDAPStoreHelper. Its bytes match the Maven Central release named in its manifest: 1.78.1 in 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.4-r3, 1.84 in 8.14.5-r3 to 8.14.5-r8, and 1.85 from 8.14.5-r9 on. The 1.78.1 LDAPStoreHelper lacks the escaping added by the fix; the 1.84 and 1.85 classes call the new org.bouncycastle.ldap.LDAPUtils helper. The range ends at 8.14.5-r3.

CVE-2026-0636 (GHSA-c3fc-8qff-9hwx): org.bouncycastle.x509.util.LDAPStoreHelper in Bouncy Castle bcprov built LDAP search filters from unescaped input, allowing LDAP injection. bcprov-jdk18on is affected from 1.74 before 1.80.2, from 1.81 before 1.81.1 and from 1.82 before 1.84 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c3fc-8qff-9hwx, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%900636, fix commit https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/commit/d20cdb8430e09224114fec0179a71859929fcbde). We read every jar, nested jars included, in every published gradle-9 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, 22 versions from 9.4.0-r0 to 9.9.2-r0, after verifying each package against its index checksum; the x86_64 and aarch64 packages of each version have the same checksum, and 9.6.1-r3 and 9.6.1-r4 are published for x86_64 only. Bouncy Castle classes appear only in /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/plugins/bcprov-jdk18on, bcpg-jdk18on and bcutil-jdk18on jars, and only the bcprov jar contains LDAPStoreHelper. Builds 9.4.0-r0 to 9.4.1-r2 ship bcprov-jdk18on 1.81, 9.5.0-r2 to 9.7.0-r1 ship 1.84 and 9.7.1-r0 to 9.8.2-r1 ship 1.85, each byte-identical to the Maven Central release; 9.9.0-r0 to 9.9.2-r0 ship a reduced bcprov-jdk18on-1.86-min.jar whose manifest names 1.86 and which is not byte-identical to the Maven Central 1.86 jar. The 1.81 LDAPStoreHelper lacks the escaping added by the fix; the classes in 1.84, 1.85 and the 1.86-min jar call the new org.bouncycastle.ldap.LDAPUtils helper. The range ends at 9.5.0-r2.
